generation_prompt: A person positions the wooden shelf and turns the Rubik's cube on its bottom level, then withdraws their hand. The robot grasps the cube with its right hand, lifts it clear of the bottom shelf, raises it to the top level, and sets it upright there, opening its fingers above the cube. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The cube stands upright on the top wooden shelf. Right fingers have opened above it while the hand remains nearby; the left hand remains clear. The bottom and middle shelf levels are empty.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active manipulator: grasps cube on bottom level, lifts and raises it, sets it upright on top level, and opens fingers above it.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open beside the table and does not touch the cube, shelf, or right hand.
arm_hand_roles.person: Positions shelf and turns cube at the beginning, then withdraws; no hand-to-hand transfer or assistance during the robot lift.

uncertainties: The right hand partly occludes the cube top and rear during the final opening; complete separation of every finger and a subsequent arm withdrawal are not shown. The cube bottom is visibly on the top shelf.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
